meta.title: Witness Of Death-Defying Reunion
meta.description: The gears of time turn anew.

units.rawText: An intense feeling of vertigo overcomes me, and I force my eyes open as a blinding headache strikes.
units.displayText: An intense feeling of vertigo overcomes me, and I force my eyes open as a blinding headache strikes.

spans.text: An intense feeling of vertigo overcomes me, and I force my eyes open as a blinding headache strikes.

units.rawText: My surroundings have not been eaten away by the Entropy, but this is not the Future Gadget Lab where we were.
units.displayText: My surroundings have not been eaten away by the Entropy, but this is not the Future Gadget Lab where we were.

spans.text: My surroundings have not been eaten away by the Entropy, but this is not the Future Gadget Lab where we were.

units.rawText: I look at the markings on the walls, and realize where I am.
units.displayText: I look at the markings on the walls, and realize where I am.

spans.text: I look at the markings on the walls, and realize where I am.

units.rawText: Is this... the Oasis base?
units.displayText: Is this... the Oasis base?

spans.text: Is this... the Oasis base?

units.rawText: Unlike the first time I saw it, the base before me shows no signs of being ravaged by Entropic corruption.
units.displayText: Unlike the first time I saw it, the base before me shows no signs of being ravaged by Entropic corruption.

spans.text: Unlike the first time I saw it, the base before me shows no signs of being ravaged by Entropic corruption.

units.rawText: Even so, it doesn't look good.
units.displayText: Even so, it doesn't look good.

spans.text: Even so, it doesn't look good.

units.rawText: I can hear the sounds of gunfire and cannons in the distance. The agents around me have pale faces and are discussing how bad the current situation is.
units.displayText: I can hear the sounds of gunfire and cannons in the distance. The agents around me have pale faces and are discussing how bad the current situation is.

spans.text: I can hear the sounds of gunfire and cannons in the distance. The agents around me have pale faces and are discussing how bad the current situation is.

units.rawText: Mayuri! Mayuri, are you alright?
units.displayText: Mayuri! Mayuri, are you alright?

spans.text: Mayuri! Mayuri, are you alright?

units.rawText: <size=40>Calm down, Okabe! Mayuri's fine!</size>
units.displayText: Calm down, Okabe! Mayuri's fine!

spans.text: Calm down, Okabe! Mayuri's fine!

units.rawText: Kuri...su?
units.displayText: Kuri...su?

spans.text: Kuri...su?

units.rawText: I slowly turn back, and a head of red hair comes into view.
units.displayText: I slowly turn back, and a head of red hair comes into view.

spans.text: I slowly turn back, and a head of red hair comes into view.

units.rawText: All sound vanishes from my mind.
units.displayText: All sound vanishes from my mind.

spans.text: All sound vanishes from my mind.

units.rawText: All breathing halts in that instant.
units.displayText: All breathing halts in that instant.

spans.text: All breathing halts in that instant.

units.rawText: That person I could never forget, the person I crossed hundreds, if not thousands of worlds to find.
units.displayText: That person I could never forget, the person I crossed hundreds, if not thousands of worlds to find.

spans.text: That person I could never forget, the person I crossed hundreds, if not thousands of worlds to find.

units.rawText: At last, she is before me again.
units.displayText: At last, she is before me again.

spans.text: At last, she is before me again.

units.rawText: ...Honestly, did you come back from the frontlines with some kind of PTSD?
units.displayText: ...Honestly, did you come back from the frontlines with some kind of PTSD?

spans.text: ...Honestly, did you come back from the frontlines with some kind of PTSD?

units.rawText: Still, suddenly calling my name gave me quite a shock... <size=40>AH!</size>
units.displayText: Still, suddenly calling my name gave me quite a shock... AH!

spans.text: Still, suddenly calling my name gave me quite a shock...
AH!

units.rawText: I rush over and take Kurisu into my arms.
units.displayText: I rush over and take Kurisu into my arms.

spans.text: I rush over and take Kurisu into my arms.

units.rawText: This is no illusion, and neither is it a lie created by my brain to cope with my misery.
units.displayText: This is no illusion, and neither is it a lie created by my brain to cope with my misery.

spans.text: This is no illusion, and neither is it a lie created by my brain to cope with my misery.

units.rawText: The warm sensation in my arms is the best proof that the girl before me actually exists.
units.displayText: The warm sensation in my arms is the best proof that the girl before me actually exists.

spans.text: The warm sensation in my arms is the best proof that the girl before me actually exists.

units.rawText: You, you, what the heck are you doing all of a sudden!
units.displayText: You, you, what the heck are you doing all of a sudden!

spans.text: You, you, what the heck are you doing all of a sudden!

units.rawText: Ku... risu...
units.displayText: Ku... risu...

spans.text: Ku... risu...

units.rawText: Were my tears always this hot?
units.displayText: Were my tears always this hot?

spans.text: Were my tears always this hot?

units.rawText: ...Okabe?
units.displayText: ...Okabe?

spans.text: ...Okabe?

units.rawText: (Sob) I'm sorry, Kurisu... I'm sorry...
units.displayText: (Sob) I'm sorry, Kurisu... I'm sorry...

spans.text: (Sob) I'm sorry, Kurisu... I'm sorry...

units.rawText: I'm so glad to see you again...
units.displayText: I'm so glad to see you again...

spans.text: I'm so glad to see you again...

units.rawText: She ceases her struggles and lets me cry all I want.
units.displayText: She ceases her struggles and lets me cry all I want.

spans.text: She ceases her struggles and lets me cry all I want.

units.rawText: Well, this isn't the usual Okabe I know.
units.displayText: Well, this isn't the usual Okabe I know.

spans.text: Well, this isn't the usual Okabe I know.

units.rawText: ...Wait a minute. Did you come from another world line?
units.displayText: ...Wait a minute. Did you come from another world line?

spans.text: ...Wait a minute. Did you come from another world line?

units.rawText: ...How long do you think we've known each other, anyway? Did you think I wouldn't notice?
units.displayText: ...How long do you think we've known each other, anyway? Did you think I wouldn't notice?

spans.text: ...How long do you think we've known each other, anyway? Did you think I wouldn't notice?

units.rawText: ...Yeah. I should have known you would.
units.displayText: ...Yeah. I should have known you would.

spans.text: ...Yeah. I should have known you would.

units.rawText: ...You must have come here for a good reason, right?
units.displayText: ...You must have come here for a good reason, right?

spans.text: ...You must have come here for a good reason, right?

units.rawText: Although I'd very much like to comfort you and tell you not to worry... Now is not the time for crying.
units.displayText: Although I'd very much like to comfort you and tell you not to worry... Now is not the time for crying.

spans.text: Although I'd very much like to comfort you and tell you not to worry... Now is not the time for crying.

units.rawText: Okabe, you still have something you need to do, right?
units.displayText: Okabe, you still have something you need to do, right?

spans.text: Okabe, you still have something you need to do, right?

units.displayText: And with that, the girl gently pushes me away before striking a pose.

spans.text: And with that, the girl gently pushes me away before striking a pose.

units.rawText: Muhahahaha! Of course!
units.displayText: Muhahahaha! Of course!

spans.text: Muhahahaha! Of course!

units.rawText: Ahem... Did I get that right?
units.displayText: Ahem... Did I get that right?

spans.text: Ahem... Did I get that right?

units.displayText: As I look at her, the long-haired girl shrinks back and looks embarrassed.

spans.text: As I look at her, the long-haired girl shrinks back and looks embarrassed.

units.rawText: Quit—quit staring at me!
units.displayText: Quit—quit staring at me!

spans.text: Quit—quit staring at me!

units.rawText: ...Pfft.
units.displayText: ...Pfft.

spans.text: ...Pfft.

units.rawText: O Assistant, I would never strike a chuuni pose like the one you just did.
units.displayText: O Assistant, I would never strike a chuuni pose like the one you just did.

spans.text: O Assistant, I would never strike a chuuni pose like the one you just did.

units.rawText: You, you're one to talk!
units.displayText: You, you're one to talk!

spans.text: You, you're one to talk!

units.rawText: Anyway, are you calmed down now, Okabe?
units.displayText: Anyway, are you calmed down now, Okabe?

spans.text: Anyway, are you calmed down now, Okabe?

units.rawText: My heart rate slowly levels off, and the gears of time begin to turn once again.
units.displayText: My heart rate slowly levels off, and the gears of time begin to turn once again.

spans.text: My heart rate slowly levels off, and the gears of time begin to turn once again.

units.rawText: Of course! The insane mad scientist Rintaro Okabe would never be defeated by this! I shall reconfigure the world! Muhahaha!
units.displayText: Of course! The insane mad scientist Rintaro Okabe would never be defeated by this! I shall reconfigure the world! Muhahaha!

spans.text: Of course! The insane mad scientist Rintaro Okabe would never be defeated by this! I shall reconfigure the world! Muhahaha!

units.rawText: Who do you think I am? I am none other than Hououin Kyouma—the Chosen of Steins Gate, the insane mad scientist!
units.displayText: Who do you think I am? I am none other than Hououin Kyouma—the Chosen of Steins Gate, the insane mad scientist!

spans.text: Who do you think I am? I am none other than Hououin Kyouma—the Chosen of Steins Gate, the insane mad scientist!

units.rawText: Yes, yes, it looks like there's no need to worry.
units.displayText: Yes, yes, it looks like there's no need to worry.

spans.text: Yes, yes, it looks like there's no need to worry.

units.rawText: Let's go look for the Professor. Okabe, can you tell us about what happened before and after the world line shift?
units.displayText: Let's go look for the Professor. Okabe, can you tell us about what happened before and after the world line shift?

spans.text: Let's go look for the Professor. Okabe, can you tell us about what happened before and after the world line shift?

units.rawText: ...And that was what happened in my previous world.
units.displayText: ...And that was what happened in my previous world.

spans.text: ...And that was what happened in my previous world.

units.rawText: I tell the people before me everything apart from Kurisu's death, which I cover up.
units.displayText: I tell the people before me everything apart from Kurisu's death, which I cover up.

spans.text: I tell the people before me everything apart from Kurisu's death, which I cover up.

units.rawText: So you're saying that after you sent your D-Mail at the Lab, you arrived at the Oasis' base?
units.displayText: So you're saying that after you sent your D-Mail at the Lab, you arrived at the Oasis' base?

spans.text: So you're saying that after you sent your D-Mail at the Lab, you arrived at the Oasis' base?

units.rawText: Yes, that's it. Something similar happened in the past.
units.displayText: Yes, that's it. Something similar happened in the past.

spans.text: Yes, that's it. Something similar happened in the past.

units.rawText: The D-Mail I sent to Erika-san changed where we met her, and I ended up appearing somewhere else.
units.displayText: The D-Mail I sent to Erika-san changed where we met her, and I ended up appearing somewhere else.

spans.text: The D-Mail I sent to Erika-san changed where we met her, and I ended up appearing somewhere else.

units.rawText: What Okabe said about "sending a D-Mail so as to keep MayQueen+Nyan² from running out of stock" aligns with what we remember.
units.displayText: What Okabe said about "sending a D-Mail so as to keep MayQueen+Nyan² from running out of stock" aligns with what we remember.

spans.text: What Okabe said about "sending a D-Mail so as to keep MayQueen+Nyan² from running out of stock" aligns with what we remember.

units.rawText: The difference is that even though you sent Ksenia the D-Mail, there was no world line shift.
units.displayText: The difference is that even though you sent Ksenia the D-Mail, there was no world line shift.

spans.text: The difference is that even though you sent Ksenia the D-Mail, there was no world line shift.

units.rawText: Shortly after that, the Oasis was invaded by Entropics, and things ended the way they did now.
units.displayText: Shortly after that, the Oasis was invaded by Entropics, and things ended the way they did now.

spans.text: Shortly after that, the Oasis was invaded by Entropics, and things ended the way they did now.

units.rawText: That's definitely different from what I remember...
units.displayText: That's definitely different from what I remember...

spans.text: That's definitely different from what I remember...

units.rawText: Comrade, how is the Oasis doing?
units.displayText: Comrade, how is the Oasis doing?

spans.text: Comrade, how is the Oasis doing?

units.rawText: While the Oasis has been attacked by the Entropics just like in your memories, things aren't as bad as the previous world line you were telling us about.
units.displayText: While the Oasis has been attacked by the Entropics just like in your memories, things aren't as bad as the previous world line you were telling us about.

spans.text: While the Oasis has been attacked by the Entropics just like in your memories, things aren't as bad as the previous world line you were telling us about.

units.rawText: The Entropics didn't suddenly spread from inside, and their attack was delayed.
units.displayText: The Entropics didn't suddenly spread from inside, and their attack was delayed.

spans.text: The Entropics didn't suddenly spread from inside, and their attack was delayed.

units.displayText: The Professor operates a console and brings up information about the Entropic disposition.

units.rawText: However, the situation still does not look good for the Oasis. We've lost many regions to the Entropics and many people have died...
units.displayText: However, the situation still does not look good for the Oasis. We've lost many regions to the Entropics and many people have died...

spans.text: However, the situation still does not look good for the Oasis. We've lost many regions to the Entropics and many people have died...

units.displayText: The air around us turns heavy.

spans.text: The air around us turns heavy.

units.rawText: Looks like I managed to negate the D-Mail sent to Riko to bring the delivery forward and returned to the previous world line.
units.displayText: Looks like I managed to negate the D-Mail sent to Riko to bring the delivery forward and returned to the previous world line.

spans.text: Looks like I managed to negate the D-Mail sent to Riko to bring the delivery forward and returned to the previous world line.

units.rawText: But why was the Oasis still attacked in this world line? Everything was clearly peaceful when I sent the D-Mail in MayQueen+Nyan²...
units.displayText: But why was the Oasis still attacked in this world line? Everything was clearly peaceful when I sent the D-Mail in MayQueen+Nyan²...

spans.text: But why was the Oasis still attacked in this world line? Everything was clearly peaceful when I sent the D-Mail in MayQueen+Nyan²...

units.rawText: ...Okabe, did you mention these world lines before?
units.displayText: ...Okabe, did you mention these world lines before?

spans.text: ...Okabe, did you mention these world lines before?

units.rawText: Yes. In a previous world line, I used John Titor's theory to convince Green-Haired to let me send a D-Mail.
units.displayText: Yes. In a previous world line, I used John Titor's theory to convince Green-Haired to let me send a D-Mail.

spans.text: Yes. In a previous world line, I used John Titor's theory to convince Green-Haired to let me send a D-Mail.

units.rawText: The structure of this world is like a length of yarn running through all of human history.
units.displayText: The structure of this world is like a length of yarn running through all of human history.

spans.text: The structure of this world is like a length of yarn running through all of human history.

units.rawText: It may seem like there's only one strand, but on closer inspection, the yarn is made of multiple threads twisted together.
units.displayText: It may seem like there's only one strand, but on closer inspection, the yarn is made of multiple threads twisted together.

spans.text: It may seem like there's only one strand, but on closer inspection, the yarn is made of multiple threads twisted together.

units.rawText: ...So you're saying that each thread is a world line?
units.displayText: ...So you're saying that each thread is a world line?

spans.text: ...So you're saying that each thread is a world line?

units.rawText: Indeed. They represent various possibilities. Among these threads is the timeline where "the antique PC didn't break".
units.displayText: Indeed. They represent various possibilities. Among these threads is the timeline where "the antique PC didn't break".

spans.text: Indeed. They represent various possibilities. Among these threads is the timeline where "the antique PC didn't break".

units.rawText: Huh, that's such an accessible analogy that I can't believe you actually came up with it, Okabe.
units.displayText: Huh, that's such an accessible analogy that I can't believe you actually came up with it, Okabe.

spans.text: Huh, that's such an accessible analogy that I can't believe you actually came up with it, Okabe.

units.rawText: We can use D-Mails to move between these world lines, and that action is called "shifting" between world lines.

units.rawText: Alright, I understand the principle behind it.

spans.text: But according to your theory... Will it really be okay to shift between world lines? Won't it cause problems?

units.rawText: Relax. Like I said, while these threads represent different paths, they all converge into one in the end and reach the same conclusion.

units.displayText: Looks like I told Kurisu about that too in this world line.

units.rawText: Can you explain this "converge into one" thing in more detail?
units.displayText: Can you explain this "converge into one" thing in more detail?

spans.text: Can you explain this "converge into one" thing in more detail?

units.rawText: Like I said before, different strands—or different world lines—will ultimately converge into one.
units.displayText: Like I said before, different strands—or different world lines—will ultimately converge into one.

spans.text: Like I said before, different strands—or different world lines—will ultimately converge into one.

units.rawText: The range of world lines that all converge to the same outcome is known as an "attractor field".

spans.text: The range of world lines that all converge to the same outcome is known as an "attractor field".
